name: Install emulator image
command: D=~/.local/share/open-teams-android; export JAVA_HOME=$D/jdk17; yes | $D/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$D/sdk "emulator" "system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64" 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo no | $D/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager create avd -n ot35 -k "system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_7 --force 2>&1 | tail -2; ls ~/.android/avd
